query:
update submissions
        set
            status = $2,
            reviewed_by = $3,
            reviewed_at = $4,
            review_comment = $5,
            raw_score = $6,
            grade_max_score = $7,
            late_periods = $8,
            penalty = $9,
            penalty_deducted_from = $10,
            work_score = $11,
            course_total_penalty = $12
        where id = $1
          and status = 'pending_review'
